title: Cohomological equivalence criterion for indecomposable module categories of a finite pointed fusion category in characteristic zero
author: Sonia Natale
source_title: On the Equivalence of Module Categories over a Group-Theoretical Fusion Category
difficulty_reason: The equivalence criterion requires tracking the associator-dependent correction to conjugation, not ordinary conjugacy of a subgroup and cocycle. The proof constructs tensor conjugation functors, computes the projective cocycle of an invertible bimodule and uses Frobenius-Perron dimensions to force its double-coset support and one-dimensional component. These categorical and cohomological constructions exceed ordinary finite-group representation qualifiers.

Explicit monoidal cochains Omega,gamma, module equivalence Rg and projective action alpha_g are retained; displayed coboundary formulas support the stated routine cocycle/coherence calculations. The converse dimension argument forces H=gLg^-1 and a trivial corrected class. Prior classification of simple bimodule support/projective components, categorical Morita correspondence and dimension identities are established cited background. Incidental denominator label in the tensor-dimension sentence and M0(H,xi) in the final rank sentence are local names, with their immediately preceding equations fixing the intended bimodule and L-category; do not edit author text.

statement_scope: Finite G, algebraically closed k of characteristic zero, normalized3-cocycle omega, C=C(G,omega) with author inverse-omega associator convention; subgroups H,L and normalized2-cochains psi,xi whose coboundaries are the corresponding restricted omega. M0(H,psi) equivalent to M0(L,xi) iff some g has H=gLg^-1 and [xi^-1 psi^g Omega_g restricted to LxL]=0 in H2(L,k^times). No ordinary untwisted conjugacy replacement.
